title: Flight
author: Gary Tarolli and Rob Mace
blurb: SGI's flight simulator in its colour-index form, from the IRIS 4D demo tape: six aircraft, an instrument panel composited in the bitplanes. Version 1.0 shipped on the IRIS 1400 in 1984; dog, its networked dogfight, is Tarolli's too.
port: Nearly original source, 25 changed lines, at the authentic 1280 by 1024; splash, plane menu, takeoff, crashes, and night mode all work. No network play yet.
inputs_detected: arrow keys, A, C, D, E, F, H, I, L, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X, Z, -, ?, ~
